## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Target branch

External contributions must target `develop`.

Pull requests to `main` are reserved for maintainer release integration from `develop`.

- [ ] The base branch is `develop`, or this is a maintainer release PR from `develop` to `main`.

## Verification

Describe how the change was tested or verified.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated modifications.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when needed.
- [ ] No private paths, credentials, secrets, or personal information were added.
